body:
TSEN2-related neurodevelopmental disorder with or without thrombotic microangiopathy

*Parent term: MONDO:0700092 (Neurodevelopmental disorder)

Definition: This condition is associated with intellectual disability; growth delay; hypotonia; motor delay; ataxia; vision issues; cardiac features (including left ventricular hypertrophy); and pulmonary complications (such as acute respiratory distress and edema). It is also linked to brain structural anomalies such as pontine and cerebellar hypoplasia; cortical atrophy; and dilated ventricles. Renal features include proteinuria, thrombotic microangiopathy, end-stage kidney disease, and high-severity hypertension. 

**Definition source: PMIDs: 18711368, 20952379, 23562994, 32404165, 38347586, 38438125, and 38622473
